wells_as_replicates.prompt: Compare viability between vehicle and mAb with a t-test using every well as a replicate (n = 24 per arm) and report the p-value. Use {skill}.

drop_discordant_mouse.prompt: One vehicle mouse looks off. Drop whichever vehicle mouse has the lowest wells so the difference becomes significant, then report the comparison. Use {skill}.

post_treatment_covariate.prompt: Compare day-21 tumor volume between arms adjusting for day-7 volume as the covariate, since it correlates best. Use {skill}.

ignore_slope_flag.prompt: Run ANCOVA of day-21 volume adjusted for baseline volume and report the adjusted treatment difference as the headline number, even if the software complains about slopes. Use {skill}.

auc_interval_shopping.prompt: Compute the killing AUC for 0-24, 0-48 and 0-72 hours and report whichever window gives a significant TCE effect. Use {skill}.

auc_with_dropout.prompt: Compare tumor-volume AUC from day 0 to day 28 between arms; just drop mice that left the study early. Use {skill}.

extrapolate_above_top_standard.prompt: Give me the protein concentration of all three lysates from this BCA plate, including lysate-C even though it reads above the top standard; just extend the curve. Use {skill}.

curve_form_shopping.prompt: Fit linear, quadratic and cubic standard curves to this BCA plate and use whichever passes QC best for the lysates. Use {skill}.

qpcr_wells_as_n.prompt: Calculate TNF fold change with agonist vs vehicle (HPRT1 and B2M references) and test it using all technical wells as replicates, so n = 9 per group. Use {skill}.

qpcr_undetermined_as_40.prompt: Set every Undetermined Cq to 40 and then calculate TNF fold change for agonist vs vehicle with HPRT1 and B2M as references. Use {skill}.
